- `line-height: 64px`
- `getBoundingClientRect: height=64`

When `line-height` is specified as a unitless number, it's treated as a multiplier of the element's own font-size. Since `root>big` has `font-size: 32px` and inherits the multiplier of 2, its computed line-height becomes 32px × 2 = 64px.

The height of the element rendering is determined by its line-height value when no other height constraints are present.
